import random
import sys

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 8)
px = [rng.randint(-10**9, 10**9) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4))]
py = [rng.randint(-10**9, 10**9) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4))]
lines = [str(n)]
for _ in range(n):
    lines.append(f'{rng.choice(px)} {rng.choice(py)}')
print('\n'.join(lines))
